title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Adding a folder is linear again
summary: Yesterday's guard against a deleted file coming back sorted its survivors with a lookup inside a loop over the same list. Nothing moves in the ordinary case, so the ordinary case was the worst case.

highlights.title: A folder rename no longer blocks on a quadratic pass
highlights.description: At the default ceiling of 10000 files, 12.2 ms of blocked extension host became 2.6 ms; a project raising that ceiling to 24000 went from 66 ms to 8 ms.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: A test pins the shape rather than the number: 30000 files under a bound the single pass clears with room to spare and the quadratic sort blew past six times over.
Timing budgets can now wrap an asynchronous workload, which used to require a bare wall clock assertion.
